requests.request: World touch log across begin(): a consumer that read the log up to some cursor in step n cannot learn what was written after that in step n once begin() restarts the log, so appliances_cooking's fridge-contents memo (cold.contents_of_units / _unchanged) re-checks by scanning every entity's location once per step (~0.03 ms on a 650-930 entity house, every substep of the bench loop and of agent episodes). Ask: keep the previous step's tail for named consumers (touched_since(cursor, consumer) valid across one begin(), e.g. a step-qualified cursor), or a monotone per-entity location epoch (w.location_epoch or a 'moved since token' query). Repro: python <scratch>/p1f_appliances_cooking/parts.py 5 (cold._unchanged 0.03-0.06 ms per substep)
